note: Desired state for macOS system daemons on every glaeda macOS host: none of these holds hot_cores for longer than hot_hours. scripts/glaeda-daemon-heal (a root LaunchDaemon) converges to it by restarting the daemon (launchd starts a fresh one); glaeda-mini-health keeps that LaunchDaemon installed and reports what it sees. A daemon with wait_idle waits for an idle host (no process named in busy) until busy_hot_hours. Seen 10-20: fseventsd at 1.0-1.7 cores for days with 13-30 GiB RSS on cmux 3/7/9/11/12/13/14 (a restart on idle cmux9 took it from 100% / 27 GiB to 1.5% / 4 MiB); audiomxd and WirelessRadioManagerd at 1.0-1.1 cores on headless aws-m4pro-5..9. A daemon at footprint_gib or more (top MEM, counting compressed and swapped pages) restarts at once, busy or not: seen 10-25, fseventsd at 102 GiB on cmuxs-mac-mini-6 with 65 GiB of swap files and 3 GiB of its 460 GiB disk free, and 54 GiB on cmuxs-mac-mini-5.

release.note: The root copy keeps itself on the stable release: every every_s it reads the channel from the first of sources that answers, and replaces its script and this policy when the release's differ (hash chain channel, release.json, archive). stale_s: how long it may lag its channel, or go without reading it, before glaeda-mini-health and glaeda-fleet-status call it daemon_heal_stale.
